'''''Cyperus albostriatus''''' is a species of [[Cyperus|sedge]] that is native to southern parts of [[Africa]], ranging from Mozambique and Zambia to South Africa.<ref name=kew>{{cite web|url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:303718-1|title=''Cyperus albostriatus'' Schrad.|access-date=30 January 2022|publisher=Kew Science – Plants of the World Online}}</ref>
